views.label: Write paths
views.note: The five ways content enters the ecosystem, and which layer each reaches.

views.label: Governed spine
views.note: The only path that confers governed status: judgment, approval, deterministic decide, verified write.

views.label: Read paths
views.note: Two independent mechanisms, each answer at the top of its own trust scale.

cards.title: One ecosystem, two layers
items: Mirror layer — written by sync, ungated: its authority comes from faithfully reflecting real files
Durable layer — reaches storage only through the gate, with provenance and a recorded confidence
Only the durable layer claims to be believed; the mirror is stored, never judged

cards.title: The governed spine
items: mb-submit-memory queries GBrain for related material, forms a genuine judgment (tagged model_based), then pauses for an explicit yes
The API derives identity from the writer's credential, never from the request — contradiction checking runs for every candidate
Decision is deterministic: promote, or route to review — no automatic rejection or quarantine; a review item blocks until a developer decides
PDLF's step-completion writer (Path 3) submits through the same gate under its own credential, parked until real steps run

cards.title: Exceptions that are real
items: Dream Cycle has no interception point — output reaches durable memory unreviewed; post-run contradiction review is always applied
The quick path (Path 5, raw remember writes) is always present by design; the discipline that routes durable work through the gate is documented, not mechanical
Sync-into-governance is prohibited by design — corpus indexing is never the governed layer's job

cards.title: Delivery and authority
items: Transactional outbox replaces a broker; retries with backoff, the index row plus the full payload are committed to the register
Answers are advisory: current files > Graphify EXTRACTED > sourced pages > the gate; both mechanisms point back to the real source
PostgreSQL: two instances, one port — every check names its instance; Cupcake mechanically polices every agent tool call
